title: Loud Shout Detector for Elders Left Alone at Home
title_te: ఇంట్లో ఒంటరిగా ఉండే పెద్దల కోసం అరుపు గుర్తించే యంత్రం
problem: When we all go to school and work, Dadi stays home alone. I worry about what would happen if she falls down in the backyard and cannot reach her phone.
idea: A listening helper. It listens for loud calls like 'Help!' or 'Amma!' and shows a flashing red alarm with a loud whistle so neighbours come. Here you can tap the sound it 'hears'.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What sound does the helper hear?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine Audio learns the sounds. Here, tap a sound.
widgets.question: The microphone hears:

options.label: Dadi shouting 'Help!'
options.result: ALARM! Dadi needs help! Neighbours, please check now!
options.te: అలారం! దాదికి సహాయం కావాలి! వెంటనే చూడండి!

options.label: Dadi crying 'Amma!'
options.result: ALARM! Someone is crying for help!

widgets.heading: ✅ Is Dadi's Home Safe from Falls?
widgets.intro: Tick the things your home already has.

items.text: Bathroom floor is dry and has a rough mat
items.te: బాత్‌రూమ్ నేల పొడిగా, జారని పట్టా ఉంది

items.text: Light near the backyard and toilet
No wires or vessels lying on the floor
Phone with big numbers kept near Dadi
items.te: పెద్ద అంకెల ఫోన్ దాది దగ్గర ఉంది

items.text: Neighbour knows to check if they hear the alarm
items.te: అలారం వింటే చూడాలని పక్కింటి వాళ్ళకు తెలుసు

items.text: Dadi knows to call 108 in an emergency

bands.text: Great! Dadi's home is much safer.
Good start. Fix the rest this week.
Let's make the home safer for Dadi today.

how: Open Teachable Machine and choose Audio Project.
Record 'Background Noise' first (quiet room, TV, fan).
Make classes like 'Help' and 'Amma'. Ask family members to say them loudly many times.
Click Train, then Export and copy the model link.
In PictoBlox, load the audio model. When 'Help' is heard, show a red flashing screen and play a loud whistle.
Tell neighbours what the alarm means, and test it together.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student making a safety alarm for my grandmother who stays alone. Write a short, loud alarm message in Telugu and English asking neighbours to come and check, and 5 simple tips to prevent falls at home for elders.
